audience: restaurants and local delivery businesses who dispatch orders with Shipday

useCases.title: See active delivery orders and their status
useCases.text: The AI lists active orders with customer, pickup place, driver, costs and order state, and opens an order by its order number.

useCases.title: Search past orders by time and status
useCases.text: The AI searches orders, including completed ones, in a time window by status, with timestamps, totals, distance and carrier.

useCases.title: Check which drivers are on shift
useCases.text: The AI lists your drivers with phone, whether they are on shift or active, and their last known location.

useCases.title: Compare on-demand delivery options and fees
useCases.text: The AI gets fee and time estimates from third-party delivery services for an order, or for a pickup and delivery address, before you book. Nothing is booked.

useCases.title: Create an order and assign or remove a driver
useCases.text: The AI creates a delivery order, then assigns it to one of your drivers, or removes the driver again.

useCases.title: Mark an order ready for pickup
useCases.text: The AI sets the ready-to-pickup flag of an order so the driver knows it is ready.
